The '''arboray tree''' was a deciduous [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]. It was planted in many [[Garden/Legends|gardens]] as a shade tree.<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
